text:
deploybot: :warning: Release promotion blocked: env-parity check failed for release v2026-03-20-rc7. Key '/prod/apps/api/SECRET_AUTH_TOKEN' exists in prod but value is empty (base64 length 0). Staging has non-empty value. See: https://deploy.internal/runs/98765

alexb: who rotated that secret? this will break auth for canaries if we promote

priya: I rotated a set of tokens during the maintenance window last night. I used a placeholder for a legacy app and apparently wrote an empty string by mistake. looking now

deploybot: parity-check: prod:/prod/apps/api/SECRET_AUTH_TOKEN -> b64:"" (empty) , staging:/staging/apps/api/SECRET_AUTH_TOKEN -> b64:"c2VjcmV0LXZhbHVlLXN0YWdpbmc="

sre-jon: marking release HOLD. change window is open but we should not promote until this is fixed. can we hotpatch prod secret?

mel: Hotpatch option available: copy staging value -> rewrap for prod KMS alias -> kubectl patch secret in prod. Need security approval and audit note. downside: short-lived mismatch vs rotation policy.

alexb: impact? have we seen failures yet?

priya: canary auth requests are returning 401/502 in the last 5m because the auth service reads an empty token and fails handshake. so we need to restore a non-empty token to prod ASAP.

ops-bot: kms-log: attempted unwrap with prod alias failed for empty payload. staging unwrap OK.

alexb: options: 1) patch prod secret with staging value and rewrap to prod alias (fast). 2) rollback release to previous image (safer but slower). 3) keep hold and perform full rotation (long). My vote: 1 + follow-up rotation.

sre-jon: agree option 1. need 2 approvals: security + prod oncall. @sam-sec please confirm.

mel: @sam-sec we need emergency approval to apply secret patch in prod and document audit trail. I'll run the patch and smoke tests.

sam-sec: Approve emergency hotpatch. Ensure audit log and open ticket for rotation fix.

priya: commands I'll run (dry-run locally first):
```bash
# grab staging secret, decode, re-encode for prod
stg_val=$(kubectl -n staging get secret api-creds -o jsonpath='{.data.SECRET_AUTH_TOKEN}' | base64 --decode)
prod_b64=$(echo -n "$stg_val" | base64)
kubectl -n prod patch secret api-creds -p '{"data":{"SECRET_AUTH_TOKEN":"'$prod_b64'"}}'
```

mel: I'll be on the terminal in 5m. will capture a short runbook entry in the release notes section: "Hotpatch: restored SECRET_AUTH_TOKEN from staging; must rotate and audit."

alexb: after patch we run smoke tests: `./scripts/smoke_auth.sh` and then re-run deploybot parity check. Also pin image for promotion to avoid any concurrent auto-rolls: image tag v1.23.4.

deploybot: Release hold applied by @eng-releases. Once patch complete, run `deploybot verify-env-parity 2101112222` to re-evaluate.

mel: applying patch now. will post output.

mel: patched prod secret, ran `./scripts/smoke_auth.sh` against canary -> all green. auth service returns 200 on token introspect. captured logs and added audit note: "hotpatch applied by mel at 2101112222, reason: empty prod secret"

mel: @deploybot please re-run parity check for release v2026-03-20-rc7

deploybot: parity-check re-run: prod:/prod/apps/api/SECRET_AUTH_TOKEN -> b64:"c2VjcmV0LXZhbHVlLXN0YWdpbmc=", staging match -> PASS. Promotion allowed.

alexb: proceeding with promotion and pinning image v1.23.4. releasing now.

mel: promotion complete. release notes updated: "Hotpatch: restored SECRET_AUTH_TOKEN in prod; follow-up: security rotation and fix rotation script to prevent empty placeholder values."

priya: I'll open PR to add validation to rotation script so placeholder empty strings are rejected and add an integration test that catches empty secret values. filing postmortem and ticket: RE-1123.

sam-sec: thanks all. approved final sign-off. :white_check_mark:
